scenes.setting: Audrey confesses to being a Beyonder — and learns her parents have known all along — then delivers the warning carefully sourced to the Psychology Alchemists: the prince's commoner girl is a Demoness of Pleasure named Trissy Cheek, the Primordial Demoness's name. 'Audrey, you've grown up.'
scenes.text_anchor: “And what scares me even more is that her name is Trissy Cheek.”

scenes.setting: Meteors coming down with no escape: Klein burns his whole matchbox to Flaming-Jump above the falling rock and hop between ignitions — until the world saturates into a still oil painting where the blast cannot reach, and a bronze-skinned man with a mole below his ear stands beside him. 'Mr. Azik!'

The dimmed quill is taken up by hand and made to write the next 'coincidence': Azik's incomplete memories flaw his passage through the spirit world, landing him and Sherlock Moriarty near Ince Zangwill and his friend
scenes.text_anchor: “Hence, he and Sherlock Moriarty found themselves landing near Ince Zangwill and his friend.”
